name: Youtarr
description: Youtarr is a self-hosted YouTube downloader that subscribes to channels and playlists and downloads new videos on a schedule with yt-dlp. It adds NFO files, posters and metadata so the videos show up cleanly in Plex, Jellyfin, Emby or Kodi.

notes.text: There is no default login: paste the one-time token from /opt/youtarr_data/config/setup-token into the web UI and create the admin account.

To keep videos on a NAS or share them with Plex or Jellyfin, mount that folder at /opt/youtarr_data/videos (pct set <CTID> -mp0 /host/path,mp=/opt/youtarr_data/videos). The host folder must be writable by UID 100000.
